lines.beaver: 오늘은 고등어 조림을 해 보자. 재료는 다 있니?
lines.beaver_en: Let's make braised mackerel today. Do you have all the ingredients?
lines.beaver_roman: Oneureun godeungeo jorimeul hae boja. Jaeryoneun da inni?
lines.learner: 네, 고등어랑 무가 있어요. 게도 사려다가 안 샀어요.
lines.en: Yes, I have mackerel and radish. I was going to buy crab too, but didn't.
lines.roman: Ne, godeungeorang muga isseoyo. Gedo saryeodaga an sasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 잘했어. 게는 다음에 하자. 도마부터 꺼내라.
lines.beaver_en: Good. We'll do crab next time. Take out the cutting board first.
lines.beaver_roman: Jalhaesseo. Geneun daeume haja. Domabuteo kkeonaera.
lines.en: I took out the cutting board. How do I trim the mackerel?

lines.beaver_en: Cut off the head and wash the inside well.
lines.learner: 네, 다 다듬었어요. 이제 냄비에 넣을까요?
lines.en: Okay, it's all trimmed. Should I put it in the pot now?
lines.roman: Ne, da dadeumeosseoyo. Ije naembie neoeulkkayo?

lines.beaver: 아니, 무를 먼저 냄비 바닥에 깔아.
lines.beaver_en: No, lay the radish on the bottom of the pot first.
lines.beaver_roman: Ani, mureul meonjeo naembi badage kkara.
lines.en: I was going to put the mackerel in first, but laid the radish instead.

lines.beaver: 잘했다. 그 위에 고등어를 올리고 양념을 부어.
lines.beaver_en: Well done. Put the mackerel on top and pour the sauce.
lines.beaver_roman: Jalhaetda. Geu wie godeungeoreul olligo yangnyeomeul bueo.
lines.learner: 양념을 다 부었어요. 불은 세게 할까요?
lines.en: I poured all the sauce. Should I turn the heat up high?
lines.roman: Yangnyeomeul da bueosseoyo. Bureun sege halkkayo?

lines.beaver: 처음엔 세게, 끓으면 약하게 해. 콩나물도 있니?
lines.beaver_en: High at first, then low once it boils. Do you have bean sprouts?
lines.beaver_roman: Cheoeumen sege, kkeureumyeon yakage hae. Kongnamuldo inni?
lines.en: Yes, I washed the bean sprouts earlier.

lines.beaver: 그럼 콩나물 무침도 하자. 콩나물을 살짝 데쳐.
lines.beaver_en: Then let's make seasoned sprouts too. Blanch them lightly.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom kongnamul muchimdo haja. Kongnamureul saljjak deochyeo.
lines.en: They're blanched. Do I add sesame oil and sesame seeds?

lines.beaver: 그래, 깨를 듬뿍 뿌려. 후식은 뭐 할까?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, sprinkle lots of sesame. What should we have for dessert?
lines.beaver_roman: Geurae, kkaereul deumppuk ppuryeo. Husigeun mwo halkka?
lines.en: I was going to buy a cream cake, but bought fruit instead.

lines.beaver: 좋아. 조림 국물이 줄었는지 봐 봐.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Check if the braising liquid has reduced.
lines.beaver_roman: Joa. Jorim gungmuri jureonneunji bwa bwa.
lines.learner: 국물이 거의 없어요. 조림이 다 된 것 같아요.
lines.en: There's almost no liquid. I think the braised dish is done.
lines.roman: Gungmuri geoui eopseoyo. Jorimi da doen geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: Good job. Now let's enjoy it!
lines.learner: 네, 도마는 제가 씻을게요. 고마워요, 엄마.
lines.en: Okay, I'll wash the cutting board. Thanks, Mom.
lines.roman: Ne, domaneun jega ssiseulgeyo. Gomawoyo, eomma.
